notes: Scope is the single BAG pand 0363100012171636 (22 m palace front). The neighbouring pand 0363100012171638 (large 1662 complex to the north and east) and 0363100012182333 (south) are not replaced; both party walls (BAG edge sharing 100% with them) are plain. Front heights follow the 3DBAG shell (eave 18.6 m, pediment apex 21.9 m); the Vingboons rear elevation print has the same height-to-width ratio (about 0.75), which cross-checks the shell. Window rows are placed as fractions of that height from the 2021 panorama. The four corner chimneys sit on the 3DBAG chimney shafts and get mortar-shaped bowls; the two front ones are photographed, the two rear ones follow the print and the LoD2 shafts. Dormers drawn in the print are not modelled (not visible from the street).
